task: Apply a fundamental improvement structure inferred from diverse history to the desktop platform.

stack_version_constraints.desktop_shell: Keep selected Tauri v2/Rust shell unchanged.

external_sources.used_for: History and incidents should produce follow-up actions and shared system learning.
Platform maturity includes product thinking and feedback loops.
Architecture quality should be preserved by continual fitness checks.
Architecture improvement can be framed as analyze, evaluate, improve.
Observability signals are standardized inputs, not the product itself.

issue_discussion_sources.signal: Practitioner discussion around balancing architecture evolution and short-term wins.

issue_discussion_notes: Community signals supported the need for bounded, incremental architecture evolution but were not treated as factual proof.
community_signal_notes: Commercial and community search results repeatedly frame historical incidents or postmortems as reusable memory; this reinforced the implementation direction but did not determine code decisions.

language_options.fit: Best fit for existing snapshot collector, tests, and generated JSON pipeline.
Best for native runtime and process work, but unnecessary for deterministic history-to-structure snapshot calculation.

language_decision_notes: The feature is a deterministic snapshot derivation over existing document metadata. Keeping it in the collector avoids runtime IPC, process lifecycle, and native resource risk while still surfacing the structure inside the Tauri desktop product.

cons: Mixes repeated signal detection with structural improvement model

architecture_options.option: Add fundamentalImprovementStructure as a derived top-level snapshot model
pros: Can expose fitness checks and improvement packages

architecture_decision_notes: Choose a new derived top-level model because the user asked for fundamental structure, not another set of pattern cards.
architecture_practitioner_sources: Local Workspace Monitor collector and UI code
architecture_tradeoff_notes: Theory favors explicit improvement loops and fitness checks; local code favors snapshot-time deterministic derivation. The implementation combines both.
code_reference_notes: Reuse the collector pattern: static rules, deterministic scoring, snapshot stats, customer sanitizer, readiness token checks.

folder_structure_options.decision: Rejected because it would blur repeated-pattern detection and structural-improvement derivation.
Selected because it keeps an inspectable ownership boundary under the existing workspace-monitor collector lib folder.

folder_structure_decision_notes: The new file belongs to the Workspace Monitor collector, not agent-platform, because it generates desktop snapshot data and UI state.
folder_semantics_notes: scripts/lib contains deterministic snapshot derivation modules.
maintainability_notes: Keep the model rule-based and evidence-bounded; future ML/vector extraction can replace scoring behind the same snapshot schema.
validation_plan: Browser smoke for Product Structure board
